id: title:Piccirello:edit github payload conditions in the trigger editor

review.posthog_relevance: Adds GitHub webhook payload condition support and metadata preservation to the Desktop app's trigger editor, allowing users to configure and retain payload filters.
review.reason: The observed changes are localized frontend and helper implementation updates. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 add payload configuration support and metadata preservation. P1.F6.H5 preserves payload condition values during backend conversion. While these support GitHub webhook triggers, the chunk lacks the backend API implementation and payload condition matching logic, preventing assessment
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the visible frontend and helper implementation, but the chunk does not include the backend API implementation or payload condition matching, which are required to establish the full tier. The tier is assigned conservatively as a maintenance/update, not a tier assignment.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the GitHub payload condition matching, repository picker, or the backend API changes. It only shows the frontend editor, storybook, and display updates. Without the backend and API implementation, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds GitHub webhook payload condition support to the Desktop app's trigger editor.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Desktop users to configure GitHub webhook triggers with payload conditions, such as matching a team slug in a review request.
